sources.title: Protect your bank passwords and PINs
Cyber Guardian: secure shopping and scam awareness
Public awareness on emerging online financial scams using the names of reputable institutions

facts.text: An OTP is confidential transaction-verification information.
A banking or card PIN must remain private.
Banking passwords must not be disclosed to another person.
A card security code is confidential payment information.
Fake prize notices can request a payment to release winnings.
Fake prize notices can collect identity details.
Scammers may promise a reward for unlocking supposedly blocked funds.
Forged documents may claim Central Bank approval is needed to release funds.
Income mainly based on recruiting participants is a pyramid warning sign.
Income mainly based on growing participant contributions is a pyramid warning sign.
Returns that are implausible for the stated risk warrant caution.
Regulatory approval of a financial provider should be independently checked.
Loan requests for phone-contact access are a privacy warning.
Loan requests for access to phone photographs and files warrant caution.
Financial agreements with unclear terms should not be accepted.
An online lender with insufficient identifying information is a warning sign.
An unusually low online selling price can be a scam indicator.
Missing delivery and return policies can indicate a dubious store.
Direct-transfer shopping payments may be difficult to recover.
Fake delivery notifications can direct people to harmful links.
Untrusted app-download sources create avoidable security risks.
A familiar institution name does not authenticate a message.
Renting or lending a bank account can enable criminal misuse.
Suspicious account activity should be reported promptly to the relevant bank.
CERT directs personal scam reports to its official incident portal.
Suspected financial scams can be reported to the nearest police station.

groups.label: Private information
groups.note: Think about what another person asked you to reveal. Never enter the actual details here.

groups.label: Money & promises
groups.note: Look at what you are being promised and how payments or earnings work.

groups.label: Links, shops & loans
groups.note: Check the request against what you can independently verify.

groups.label: What has happened so far?
groups.note: These answers help identify whether you should contact your bank immediately.

questions.label: Did someone ask you to tell them your OTP?
questions.hint: An OTP is a one-time code. This means sharing it with a person, not entering it yourself in a verified service.

questions.label: Did someone ask for your banking or card PIN?
questions.hint: Do not enter the actual PIN here.

questions.label: Did someone ask for your banking password?
questions.hint: Include calls, chats, or messages requesting the password.

questions.label: Did a caller or message ask you to disclose your card security code?
questions.hint: This means giving the code to a person, not using a verified checkout yourself.

questions.label: Does the sender claim to represent a bank or official institution?
questions.hint: A logo or familiar name alone does not verify identity.

questions.label: Have you been told you won an unexpected prize?
questions.hint: For example, a cash draw you do not recall entering.

questions.label: Must you pay money to receive the promised prize or released funds?
questions.hint: Include processing, clearance, or release fees.

questions.label: Does the prize claim ask for your NIC or passport details?
questions.hint: Only answer whether details were requested.

questions.label: Are you offered a reward for helping unlock someone else’s blocked funds?
questions.hint: This includes alleged foreign funds or frozen balances.

questions.label: Do they claim Central Bank approval will unlock those funds?
questions.hint: Include letters or documents making that claim.

questions.label: Does the scheme mainly pay you for recruiting new members?
questions.hint: Focus on the main source of earnings, not ordinary product sales.

questions.label: Do earnings mainly depend on members adding more money?
questions.hint: Include upgrades or increasing member contributions.

questions.label: Are unusually high returns promised with little or no risk?
questions.hint: Consider the promise in relation to the claimed risk.

questions.label: Are you asked to rent your bank account or pass others’ money through it?
questions.hint: For example, keeping a commission for moving someone else’s funds.

questions.label: Have you been unable to independently verify the investment provider’s authorisation?
questions.hint: Answer No only if you have checked through the relevant official source; otherwise choose Not sure.

questions.label: Is this an online or mobile loan offer?
questions.hint: This provides context for the next four questions.

questions.label: Does the loan app request access to your contacts?
questions.hint: Include permissions to read your address book.

questions.label: Does the loan app request access to photos or files?
questions.hint: Consider permissions unrelated to a clear, necessary purpose.

questions.label: Are the loan terms, fees, or repayment conditions unclear?
questions.hint: Answer based on whether you understand the agreement.

questions.label: Is adequate information about the lender missing?
questions.hint: For example, an independently verifiable identity and contact details.

questions.label: Is the online seller’s price unusually low?
questions.hint: Compare with similar products from established sellers.

questions.label: Are the online store’s delivery and return policies missing?
questions.hint: Check information you can actually find.

questions.label: Does the seller insist on a direct bank transfer?
questions.hint: This alone does not prove fraud.

questions.label: Is this a parcel or delivery notification?
questions.hint: Include messages about a delivery you were not expecting.

questions.label: Does the message include a link you cannot independently verify?
questions.hint: Do not open the link just to answer this question.

questions.label: Are you asked to install an app from an untrusted download link?
questions.hint: For example, a file sent by an unknown sender.

questions.label: Have you already sent money in this suspicious situation?
questions.hint: Only confirm whether a payment was made; do not provide account details.

questions.label: Have you already disclosed an OTP, PIN, banking password, or card security code?
questions.hint: Answer about this suspicious situation.

questions.label: Have you noticed a banking transaction you did not authorise?
questions.hint: Check through your bank’s official app or another trusted channel.

questions.label: Do you want to report a suspected financial or social-media scam?
questions.hint: This provides the official CERT reporting route; it does not send a report.

rules.title: OTP disclosure request
rules.why: A request to disclose an OTP exposes confidential verification information.
rules.locator: Confidential information list and non-disclosure advice
rules.evidence: OTPs are among the protected account-access details.

rules.title: PIN disclosure request
rules.why: A PIN request is a credential-protection warning.
rules.locator: Confidential information list and non-disclosure advice
rules.evidence: PINs are included in confidential banking information.

rules.title: Banking password request
rules.why: A banking password request is a credential-protection warning.
rules.locator: Confidential information list and non-disclosure advice
rules.evidence: Banking passwords must be kept confidential.

rules.title: Card security-code request
rules.why: The request concerns confidential payment information.
rules.locator: Confidential information list and non-disclosure advice
rules.evidence: Card security codes are listed as confidential details.

rules.title: Possible institution impersonation
rules.why: An institution claim combined with a credential request needs independent verification.
rules.locator: The Four Rules: protect your information; check before you act
rules.evidence: Official identity claims do not justify asking for secret credentials.

rules.title: Tell the bank about the request
rules.why: CBSL advises informing the bank when a third party requests confidential account-access information.
rules.locator: Final body paragraph: requests for confidential account access
rules.evidence: Inform the bank if another party requests account-access information.

rules.title: Prize payment warning
rules.why: An unexpected prize requiring payment matches a documented scam pattern.
rules.locator: Body paragraph on prizes, fees and identity details
rules.evidence: Fraudulent prize notices ask for release fees.

rules.title: Prize identity-collection warning
rules.why: An unexpected prize collecting identity details needs verification.
rules.locator: Body paragraph on prizes, fees and identity details
rules.evidence: Fraudulent prize notices seek NIC or passport information.

rules.title: Blocked-funds reward warning
rules.why: A reward for unlocking supposedly blocked funds matches the documented warning.
rules.locator: Opening paragraph: rewards for unlocking blocked funds
rules.evidence: A promised reward for unlocking funds is a documented tactic.

rules.title: Alleged approval warning
rules.why: A blocked-funds reward relying on alleged Central Bank approval is suspicious.
rules.locator: Paragraph on forged letters and alleged CBSL approval
rules.evidence: Scam documents can claim approval is needed to release funds.

rules.title: Recruitment-based earnings
rules.why: Recruitment is the reported main income source, which is a pyramid warning sign.
rules.locator: Opening definition of prohibited pyramid schemes
rules.evidence: Primary earnings from recruiting participants are a warning pattern.

rules.title: Contribution-based earnings
rules.why: Earnings reportedly rely on expanding participant contributions.
rules.locator: Opening definition of prohibited pyramid schemes
rules.evidence: Primary earnings from increased participant contributions are a warning pattern.

rules.title: Unrealistic return warning
rules.why: A very high return paired with little risk warrants verification.
rules.locator: The Four Rules: question unrealistic returns
rules.evidence: Very high returns with low risk require caution.

rules.title: Provider verification needed
rules.why: The provider’s authorisation has not been independently established.
rules.locator: Scam Files: unregistered finance companies
rules.evidence: Check regulatory approval before trusting an investment provider.

rules.title: Loan contact-access warning
rules.why: The loan application seeks access to phone contacts.
rules.locator: Page 1: mobile-loan characteristics and data-access advice
rules.evidence: Loan-related access to phone contacts is discouraged.

rules.title: Loan file-access warning
rules.why: The loan application seeks access to personal phone files.
rules.locator: Page 1: mobile-loan characteristics and data-access advice
rules.evidence: Loan-related access to photographs and files is discouraged.

rules.title: Unclear loan agreement
rules.why: The loan terms are not understood well enough for an informed agreement.
rules.locator: Page 1: advice to understand transaction terms
rules.evidence: Understand the financial agreement before accepting it.

rules.title: Unclear lender identity
rules.why: Insufficient lender information prevents a reliable check.
rules.locator: Page 1: lender information and mobile-loan characteristics
rules.evidence: Obtain sufficient information about the lender.

rules.title: Unusually low shopping price
rules.why: An unusually low price is one of the shopping indicators listed by CERT.
rules.locator: Page 1: Know the Warning Signs
rules.evidence: Extremely low selling prices can signal a scam.

rules.title: Store transparency warning
rules.why: Missing delivery or return policies are shopping warning signs listed by CERT.
rules.locator: Page 1: Know the Warning Signs
rules.evidence: Missing delivery or return policies can signal a scam.

rules.title: Delivery-link warning
rules.why: The delivery message contains a link you cannot independently verify.
rules.locator: Page 1: Watch Out for Fake Delivery Scams
rules.evidence: Fake parcel messages use links to obtain information or install malware.

rules.title: Unverified message link
rules.why: Avoid a questionable message link and access the genuine service directly.
rules.locator: Page 2: Protect Yourself from Scams
rules.evidence: Avoid questionable message links; visit the service directly.

rules.title: Untrusted app warning
rules.why: An untrusted download link should not be used to install an app.
rules.locator: Page 2: Protect Yourself from Scams
rules.evidence: Use official download sources instead of untrusted app files.

rules.title: Account misuse warning
rules.why: The request involves using your bank account to handle another party’s money.
rules.locator: Scam Files: bank-account lending or renting
rules.evidence: Others may misuse a borrowed or rented bank account.

rules.title: Payment already made
rules.why: Money was sent in a situation you consider suspicious. Contact the bank promptly.
rules.locator: Precautions: final item on suspected victims
rules.evidence: A suspected fraud victim should promptly inform their bank.

rules.title: Credentials already shared
rules.why: Confidential access information has already been disclosed.
rules.locator: Precautions: final item on suspected victims
rules.evidence: A suspected fraud victim should promptly inform their bank.

rules.title: Unrecognised transaction
rules.why: The reported transaction was not authorised by you.
rules.locator: Final body paragraph: unexpected transaction notifications
rules.evidence: Inform the bank about transactions not initiated by the account holder.

rules.title: Direct-deposit shopping payment
rules.why: CERT lists direct bank deposits among shopping warning signs; this alone does not prove fraud.
rules.locator: Page 1: Know the Warning Signs; Use Secure Payment Methods
rules.evidence: Direct deposits are a listed warning and can be hard to recover.

rules.title: Report a suspected pyramid scheme
rules.why: CBSL identifies Police as a reporting route for suspected pyramid schemes.
rules.locator: Reporting guidance following the pyramid-scheme definition
rules.evidence: Report suspected pyramid schemes to Police or CBSL.

rules.title: Verify the claimed prize directly
rules.why: CBSL advises direct verification with the named institution for this type of notification.
rules.locator: Final body paragraph: verify directly with the named institution
rules.evidence: Check the notification directly with the institution it names.

rules.title: Official CERT reporting route
rules.why: CERT directs personal financial and social-media scam reports to its incident portal.
rules.locator: Important Notice: social-media and financial-fraud incidents
rules.evidence: Personal scam reports belong in the official incident portal.

flag(credentials).label: Confidential details requested
flag(credentials).advice: Do not disclose the requested code or password. Contact the institution through its official app, website, or the number on your card.

flag(provider).label: Provider not independently verified
flag(provider).advice: Check the provider’s authorisation with the appropriate regulator before committing funds.

category(impersonation).label: Verify the claimed institution
category(impersonation).advice: End the conversation and contact the claimed institution through a channel you find independently.

category(prize).label: Possible prize scam
category(prize).advice: Pause any fee payment or identity disclosure. Verify the claimed prize directly with the named organisation.

category(blocked_funds).label: Possible blocked-funds scam
category(blocked_funds).advice: Do not send money to release the alleged funds. Verify any claimed official approval independently.

category(pyramid).label: Pyramid-scheme warning signs
category(pyramid).advice: Pause participation and recruitment. Consult CBSL’s current guidance; this tool does not determine whether a named scheme is illegal.

category(investment).label: Unrealistic investment promise
category(investment).advice: Ask for independently verifiable information on risks and authorisation. Do not rely on a promised return.

category(loan_privacy).label: Intrusive loan-app permissions
category(loan_privacy).advice: Do not grant the requested phone access. Verify the lender and review the privacy terms.

category(loan_terms).label: Loan information needs checking
category(loan_terms).advice: Get clear lender information, fees, and repayment terms before accepting the agreement.

category(shopping).label: Online shopping warning signs
category(shopping).advice: Verify the seller independently and review the purchase and payment protections before paying.

category(delivery).label: Suspicious delivery link
category(delivery).advice: Avoid the message link. Check the delivery using the courier’s independently located official service.

category(phishing).label: Avoid the unverified message link
category(phishing).advice: Do not follow the questionable link. Open the genuine service directly if you need to sign in.

category(download).label: Untrusted app download
category(download).advice: Do not install the file. Use a verified official source for the app you need.

category(account_misuse).label: Possible bank-account misuse
category(account_misuse).advice: Do not rent your account or move unknown funds for someone else. Ask your bank for guidance.

action(contact_bank).label: Contact your bank now
action(contact_bank).advice: Use the official banking app, card contact number, or branch. Explain what happened and ask about securing access and the transaction.

action(report_cert).label: Use the CERT incident portal
action(report_cert).advice: Follow the reporting guidance at cert.gov.lk/report_incident. The CERT hotline is 101.

action(report_police).label: Report the suspected scam to Police
action(report_police).advice: Contact your nearest police station. Keep relevant messages, payment references, and dates available for the report.

action(verify_institution).label: Verify the prize with the named institution
action(verify_institution).advice: Use contact details obtained independently from the institution’s official website or branch.
